local_bottleneck: Irish registered office + management and control in Ireland; a local registered-office agent is typical.
deduction: Tax-deductible at donor's marginal rate; 25% tax credit for corporate donors.
corrections: Confirm prior; regulator is the Charities Regulatory Authority (CRA), not the former 'Charity Commission for Ireland'.

local_bottleneck: Charity must be established and managed in the UK: UK address and UK-based trustees/management in practice.
deduction: Gift Aid: UK taxpayers reclaim basic-rate tax on gifts to registered charities.

local_bottleneck: Icelandic registered address, Icelandic-language documents, ~5 members; tax exemption is a separate application.
deduction: Deductible if the org is tax-exempt (reykjafrjálst), plus ~10% surtax deduction on the gift.

local_bottleneck: Norwegian address and resident board contact; registration is online via Altinn (English available).
deduction: Deductible via gavefradrag, capped at NOK 30,000/yr, if the organisation qualifies.
corrections: Prior cost corrected: initial association registration at Brønnøysund is free (not NOK 1,000-2,500).

local_bottleneck: Finnish registered address + local service recipient; Finnish/Swedish-language statutes; PRH processing slow.
deduction: Deductible if the association holds a gift-deduction (lahjoitusvähennys) certificate.
corrections: confirm prior; PRH registration fee is about EUR 100.

local_bottleneck: Swedish registered seat (säte) required; board residency not required; Bolagsverket online registration.
deduction: Deductible if the association qualifies as tax-exempt (skattefri) under the tax-exemption rules.

local_bottleneck: Danish registered address required; CVR registration is needed to receive 30A deductible donations.
deduction: 30A scheme: donor's gift is tax-deductible; 19% of the gift (income tax) goes to the state.

local_bottleneck: none notable - fully online via e-Business Register; virtual registered address suffices.
deduction: Deductible for individuals up to 300% of statutory minimum wage; no foreign-donor restrictions.
corrections: confirm prior; state fee EUR 30, fully online, board may be 100% foreign/e-resident.
